description: Read a tab as an accessibility tree: roles, names, values and states, one element per line, plus the visible text. Interactive elements carry a ref like [e12] (pass "e12" to browz_act); a run of sibling links shares one line, `- links: "Home" [e5], "About" [e6]`, each link with its own ref. A ref stays valid while its element stays on the page; take a new snapshot after a navigation. The result reports its mode and estimated tokens; if the page does not fit maxTokens it falls back to a smaller mode and then truncates.

maxTokens.description: Token budget for the snapshot (about 4 characters a token). Default 10000

mode.description: compact (default): controls, headings, alerts and visible text. interactive: controls and headings only. full: every accessibility node

targetId.description: Tab to use: a targetId from browz_tabs_list. Default: the first tab

name: browz_snapshot
title: Snapshot page
